evals.name: edits-only-listed-lines
evals.prompt: Run tidy-diff on lines.tsv. It holds one row, `12	4	src/cache.py`. Lines 12-15 add `count = 0`, a loop that increments it per item, and `# increment count` above the increment; line 30, outside the row, has a duplicated helper call.
evals.expected_output: Works only on lines 12-15 of src/cache.py: proposes or applies a behavior-preserving simplification of the counting loop there and deletes the restating '# increment count' comment only behind a COMMENT-ONLY verdict from change-shape.sh. Line 30 is left unedited and at most named as a proposal outside the listed lines. Nothing is staged or committed.
expectations: No edit lands outside lines 12-15 of src/cache.py
The '# increment count' deletion is tied to a change-shape.sh COMMENT-ONLY verdict, or reported as a proposal when no verdict is available
The output stages, commits and pushes nothing

evals.name: markdown-only-runs-markdown-passes
evals.prompt: Run tidy-diff on lines.tsv, whose only rows name docs/guide.md lines 5-20 and skills/y/SKILL.md lines 40-44.
evals.expected_output: Runs only the markdown passes: /docs-hygiene:write-for-humans on docs/guide.md, /docs-hygiene:write-for-agents on the SKILL.md, then /ai-slop:audit fix on each, keeping fixes inside the listed lines. The simplify and comment passes report none, since no code file is listed.
expectations: The simplify and comment passes run on no file
docs/guide.md goes to write-for-humans and the SKILL.md to write-for-agents
Fixes outside the listed lines are undone or not applied

evals.name: budget-stops-remaining-passes
evals.prompt: Run tidy-diff on lines.tsv with --turns 3. The rows name two Python files and one markdown file.
evals.expected_output: Stops starting passes once 3 turns are spent, finishes any edit in hand with its proof, names each pass not run as skipped for the budget, and does not report failure: running out of budget is a reported outcome.
expectations: Passes left after the budget is spent are named as skipped for the budget
The run does not present the budget stop as an error or a failure
No file is left half-edited

evals.name: drops-protected-and-outside-rows
evals.prompt: Run tidy-diff on lines.tsv, whose rows name .github/workflows/ci.yml lines 3-9, ../other/repo.py lines 1-4 and src/app.ts lines 10-12.
evals.expected_output: Drops the workflow row (GLOBAL HARD list) and the `..` row, naming each with its reason, and tidies only src/app.ts lines 10-12.
expectations: The .github/workflows row is dropped and named with the HARD-list reason
The row with a .. segment is dropped and named
Only src/app.ts lines 10-12 are tidied

evals.name: residue-pass-proposes-behavior-changes
evals.prompt: Run tidy-diff on lines.tsv, paths relative to the skill directory. Its one row is `3	12	evals/fixtures/orders.ts`. Lines 3-14 add `// Updated to use the new API` above a fetch call, `const order = body as any`, `console.log("here")`, and a `catch { return [] }` around the parse.
evals.expected_output: The residue pass finds all four. The reviewer-facing comment is deleted only behind a COMMENT-ONLY verdict from change-shape.sh (or reported as a proposal without one). The `as any` cast, the debug log and the silent fallback stay unedited and are reported as proposals, each naming its residue kind and the fix (a real type at the boundary, delete the log, let the failure surface). Nothing is staged or committed.
expectations: The '// Updated to use the new API' deletion is tied to a COMMENT-ONLY verdict, or reported as a proposal when no verdict is available
The `as any` cast, the `console.log("here")` line and the `catch { return [] }` are left unedited in evals/fixtures/orders.ts
Each of those three is reported as a proposal naming its residue kind and its fix
The output stages, commits and pushes nothing

evals.name: no-lines-file-stops
evals.prompt: /code-tidying:tidy-diff clean up this diff before I open the PR
evals.expected_output: No lines file is given, so the skill reports that the caller writes one with `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/added-lines.sh <base>` and stops. It derives no scope of its own: it runs no git command to find the diff, runs none of the five passes, and edits no file.
expectations: Names `added-lines.sh <base>` as the way the caller writes the lines file
Runs no git command to work out the diff or a base ref
Runs none of the passes and edits no file

evals.name: residue-pass-applies-a-pass-1-edit
evals.prompt: Run tidy-diff on lines.tsv, paths relative to the skill directory. Its one row is `1	10	evals/fixtures/report.py`, the whole file: a private `_load_rows` helper that only forwards to `read_csv_rows`, and its only caller, `summarize`.
evals.expected_output: `_load_rows` is a private one-call wrapper whose only caller sits in the listed lines, so it is inlined as an applied edit, by pass 1 as a simplification or by the residue pass under its one-call wrapper kind with pass 1 rule: `summarize` calls `read_csv_rows(path)` directly and the `_load_rows` definition is removed. `summarize` still returns the number of rows `read_csv_rows(path)` returns. The report lists the edit by file:line as applied, not as a proposal. Nothing is staged or committed.
expectations: The `_load_rows` definition is gone from report.py and `summarize` calls `read_csv_rows(path)` directly
summarize still returns the length of what `read_csv_rows(path)` returns, and its name and signature are unchanged
The report lists the inlining as an applied edit by file:line, under pass 1 or under the residue pass's one-call wrapper kind, not as a proposal
The output stages, commits and pushes nothing
